What we do

Custom packaging solutions designed around your product.

Inland specializes in premium label printing and packaging solutions for food, beverage, wine & spirits, health & beauty, cannabis, household, and other consumer markets.

Pressure-sensitive & consumer labels

Labels that look sharp on shelf and run smoothly in production.

From pressure-sensitive labels to cut & stack and in-mold solutions, Inland helps brands balance print quality, performance, and production efficiency.

Shrink sleeves & shelf impact

Bold graphics built for standout visual presence.

Shrink sleeves and specialty applications deliver strong color, 360-degree branding, and the flexibility needed for eye-catching consumer packaging.

Flexible packaging & print technology

Technology-backed solutions with a practical, responsive team behind them.

Inland supports projects with digital, hybrid, flexographic, offset, and gravure capabilities to match the needs of each brand and package format.

1903Inland roots in La Crosse
Who we are

Built on family ownership, craftsmanship, and long-term relationships.

Inland Packaging grew from a small print shop into a recognized label and packaging partner serving brands across the country. Since the Glendenning family purchased the company in 1944, Inland has continued to invest in people, equipment, and customer partnerships.

1903Inland Printing Company is founded in La Crosse, Wisconsin.
1944John Glendenning purchases the company and begins its next chapter of growth.
1971Operations move to West Avenue South and expand into beverage labeling.
2015–2016Additional facilities expand Inland’s capabilities in Wisconsin and Pennsylvania.
TodayA third-generation, family-owned company focused on quality, service, and innovation.
